title: "About Me"

Hi, I’m Gavin Boss — an analytics professional with more than **8 years of experience in intelligence analysis** and a recently completed **Master of Science in Applied Business Analytics from Boston University**.

My professional background has focused on solving complex problems, identifying meaningful patterns, and translating analysis into clear recommendations for senior decision-makers. I currently work as an **All-Source Analyst supporting USCENTCOM**, where I operate in a high-tempo environment that requires analytical rigor, sound judgment, and the ability to work with complex and incomplete information.

While completing my graduate degree, I expanded that analytical foundation into business and data analytics through hands-on work with **Python, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, statistical modeling, predictive analytics, machine learning, forecasting, simulation, and data visualization**.

I am now focused on transitioning from government contracting and national-security analysis into the private sector, where I can apply both my professional analytical experience and technical skill set to business problems.

My long-term goal is to continue developing expertise in **data analytics, business intelligence, predictive modeling, and analytical automation**, while helping organizations make better decisions through clear, data-driven insight.
